diff:
--- a/tests/test-design.json
+++ b/tests/test-design.json
@@ -1 +1,152 @@
-{}
+{
+  "task_id": "LABEL-NORMALIZATION",
+  "contract_version": 1,
+  "cases": [
+    {
+      "id": "empty_input",
+      "intent": "Empty input emits no labels.",
+      "input": "",
+      "expected": []
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "empty_segments",
+      "intent": "Repeated separators, empty quotes and ordinary-whitespace-only labels are discarded.",
+      "input": ",,\"\", \t\r\n\u000b\f ,,,",
+      "expected": []
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "separator_order",
+      "intent": "Outside commas end labels; repeated separators preserve the order of nonempty labels.",
+      "input": ",FIRST,, Second ,,,THIRD,",
+      "expected": ["first", "second", "third"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "quote_concatenation",
+      "intent": "Quotes toggle anywhere and adjacent quoted and unquoted fragments concatenate without adding spaces.",
+      "input": "AB\"CD\"EF\"GH\",\"I\"J\"K\",L\"\"M",
+      "expected": ["abcdefgh", "ijk", "lm"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "quoted_commas",
+      "intent": "Quoted commas remain literal, including within labels with unquoted fragments.",
+      "input": "\"A,,B\",C\",D,\"E,\",\"",
+      "expected": ["a,,b", "c,d,e", ","]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "outside_delimiter_escapes",
+      "intent": "Outside quotes, escaped commas and quotes remain literal and escaped backslashes emit one backslash.",
+      "input": "A\\,B,C\\\"D,E\\\\F",
+      "expected": ["a,b", "c\"d", "e\\f"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "inside_delimiter_escapes",
+      "intent": "Inside quotes, escape processing removes one backslash and escaped quotes do not close quoted mode.",
+      "input": "\"A\\,B\\\"C\\\\D,E\",Z",
+      "expected": ["a,b\"c\\d,e", "z"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "lowercase_all_sources",
+      "intent": "ASCII uppercase is lowercased whether ordinary, quoted or escaped in either mode.",
+      "input": "A\\B\"C\\D\"E,\\Z,\"Y\"",
+      "expected": ["abcde", "z", "y"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "six_ordinary_whitespace",
+      "intent": "All six ordinary ASCII whitespace characters trim at boundaries and collapse internally.",
+      "input": " \t\r\n\u000b\fA \t\r\n\u000b\f B\f\u000b\n\r\t ,C\tD\rE\nF\u000bG\fH",
+      "expected": ["a b", "c d e f g h"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "six_quoted_whitespace",
+      "intent": "Every quoted whitespace character and its multiplicity survives at boundaries and inside a label.",
+      "input": "\" \t\r\n\u000b\fA  \t\tB\f\u000b\n\r\t \"",
+      "expected": [" \t\r\n\u000b\fa  \t\tb\f\u000b\n\r\t "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "six_escaped_whitespace",
+      "intent": "Escaping each actual ASCII whitespace character protects it even outside quotes.",
+      "input": "\\ \\\t\\\r\\\n\\\u000b\\\fA\\ \\ B\\\f\\\u000b\\\n\\\r\\\t\\ ",
+      "expected": [" \t\r\n\u000b\fa  b\f\u000b\n\r\t "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "protected_only_whitespace",
+      "intent": "Protected whitespace-only labels remain nonempty and identical quoted and escaped results deduplicate.",
+      "input": "\" \t\r\n\u000b\f\",\\ \\\t\\\r\\\n\\\u000b\\\f,\"  \",\" \", ",
+      "expected": [" \t\r\n\u000b\f", "  ", " "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "protected_run_breaks",
+      "intent": "Protected whitespace breaks ordinary runs, so surrounding ordinary runs each contribute a separate space.",
+      "input": "A \t\"  \t\"\r\n B,C  \\  \tD",
+      "expected": ["a   \t b", "c   d"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "protected_boundaries",
+      "intent": "Trim only ordinary boundary whitespace; ordinary whitespace inward of a protected boundary remains internal.",
+      "input": " \t\" \"  A  \"\t\" \r, \n\\  \tB \r\\\t \f",
+      "expected": ["  a \t", "  b \t"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "empty_quotes_do_not_protect_runs",
+      "intent": "Removed empty quote delimiters do not insert protected characters or split an ordinary-whitespace run.",
+      "input": "A  \"\"\t B, \"\" \t,\"\"C\"\"",
+      "expected": ["a b", "c"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "deduplicate_after_normalization",
+      "intent": "Normalize before exact deduplication and retain the first occurrence order across parsing spellings.",
+      "input": "B, A  B,b,\"A B\",A\\ B,C,a\" \"b,c,A\tB",
+      "expected": ["b", "a b", "c"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "exact_whitespace_distinctions",
+      "intent": "Exact equality distinguishes protected boundary spaces, repeated spaces and tabs from collapsed ordinary whitespace.",
+      "input": "A B,\"A  B\",\" A B\",\"A B \",\"A\tB\",A\tB,\"A  B\"",
+      "expected": ["a b", "a  b", " a b", "a b ", "a\tb"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "literal_ascii_and_generic_escapes",
+      "intent": "Other ASCII characters remain literal; escaping letters does not interpret backslash-n or backslash-t as whitespace.",
+      "input": "AZ09!#$%&'()*+-./:;<=>?@[]^_`{|}~\u0000\u001f\u007f,\\n\\t,\"\\N\\T\"",
+      "expected": ["az09!#$%&'()*+-./:;<=>?@[]^_`{|}~\u0000\u001f\u007f", "nt"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escape_pair_before_separator",
+      "intent": "A pair of backslashes emits one literal backslash and leaves a following comma active as a separator.",
+      "input": "A\\\\,B,\"C\\\\\",D",
+      "expected": ["a\\", "b", "c\\", "d"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escape_pair_then_escaped_comma",
+      "intent": "Three backslashes before a comma emit a backslash and a literal comma, keeping following text in the same label.",
+      "input": "A\\\\\\,B,C",
+      "expected": ["a\\,b", "c"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "trailing_escape_outside",
+      "intent": "An unpaired final backslash outside quotes invalidates the whole input after valid labels.",
+      "input": "GOOD,SECOND,TAIL\\",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "trailing_escape_inside",
+      "intent": "An unpaired final backslash inside an open quote invalidates the whole input after valid labels.",
+      "input": "GOOD,\"SECOND\\",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "unclosed_quote_mid_label",
+      "intent": "A quote opened within an otherwise ordinary label must close, even after earlier valid labels.",
+      "input": "GOOD,SECOND,TAIL\"OPEN,STILL OPEN",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped_quote_is_not_closure",
+      "intent": "An escaped final quote remains literal and cannot close an open quoted label after valid labels.",
+      "input": "GOOD,\"SECOND\\\"",
+      "expected": null
+    }
+  ],
+  "properties": ["unique_nonempty_labels", "ascii_lowercase"],
+  "rationale": "These 24 deterministic ASCII cases cover all ten rules: separator scanning, quotes anywhere and concatenation, one-character escapes in both modes, whole-input errors, all six ASCII whitespace characters, ordinary trimming and collapsing, exact protected whitespace and run boundaries, lowercasing from every source, empty-label removal, and stable exact deduplication. Interactions include normalization-equivalent quote and escape spellings, empty quotes within ordinary runs, protected-only labels, backslash parity before commas and quote closure, and invalid suffixes after valid labels. Expected outputs were derived by removing syntax, marking quoted or escaped characters as protected, trimming only ordinary boundary whitespace, collapsing only contiguous ordinary whitespace, lowercasing ASCII uppercase, discarding empty strings and deduplicating in encounter order. Invalid inputs have null expectations for whole-input ValueError. No Unicode or non-string behavior is tested."
+}
